mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates worsening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months with rising UNRATE, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% signals aggressive monetary easing by the Federal Reserve, lowering discount rates and stimulating equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months with FEDFUNDS < 1.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) and declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 107.5%) indicate deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months meeting UNRATE > 6.0 AND INDPRO < 107.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession, a decline in housing starts below 800 thousand units signals continued weakness in the residential sector, causing S&P 500 to fall over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months with HOUST < 800 during a recession, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 107.0 (relative to 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months with INDPRO < 107.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 360 billion dollars signals weak consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of months with RSAFS < 360000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate is below 1.0% and unemployment exceeds 6.0%, the combination of aggressive monetary policy and labor market distress causes S&P 500 to decline over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months meeting FEDFUNDS < 1.0 AND UNRATE > 6.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession, a housing starts decline below 800 thousand units predicts sustained negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of months with HOUST < 800 during a recession, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
